name: Jimwel Cruz — Full-Stack Web Development
description: Full-stack web development, e-commerce builds, UI implementation, performance optimization, accessibility audits, and responsive design.

itemOffered.name: Full-Stack Development
itemOffered.description: Production-ready web applications from database to interface: schema design, APIs, authentication, and responsive React front ends.

itemOffered.name: E-commerce Development
itemOffered.description: Shopify and custom storefronts with product catalog architecture, cart and checkout flows, payment integration, and performance tuning.

itemOffered.name: UI Implementation
itemOffered.description: Pixel-accurate, responsive interfaces built from design files, with reusable component systems that hold up at every breakpoint.

itemOffered.name: Performance Optimization
itemOffered.description: Core Web Vitals tuning through code splitting, image optimization, caching, and bundle analysis for faster load times.

itemOffered.name: Accessibility Audits
itemOffered.description: WCAG-oriented reviews of keyboard navigation, screen-reader support, contrast, and focus management, with fixes implemented.

itemOffered.name: Responsive Design
itemOffered.description: Mobile-first layouts that preserve content and interaction quality from 320px phones to 4K monitors.
